name: taha-traders
description: Taha Traders wholesale tailoring materials website + admin

scripts.predev: node -e "try{require('child_process').execSync('powershell -NoProfile -Command \"Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }\"',{stdio:'ignore'})}catch(e){}"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
